retrievalProfile.description: A surreal nocturnal scene featuring a central figure perched on a massive rock overlooking water, characterized by a vibrant magenta-to-purple gradient sky and scattered goats.
triggerTerms: man sitting on a cliff at night with goats
magenta and purple night sky landscape

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy digital composition showing a man in a denim shirt sitting on the edge of a large, textured boulder. He is surrounded by small goats at various elevations. The background features a deep magenta and purple twilight sky with a glowing full moon, overlooking a dark body of water and distant hills.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure perched atop a central vertical rock mass
Vibrant magenta sky contrasting with dark foreground shadows
Small goats distributed across the rocky terrain for scale
Full moon positioned in the upper right quadrant
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
Deep purple and magenta color palette in the sky
Central rock formation acting as the primary anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human figure is medium-scale, seated at the top-center of a large rock that occupies the left and center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, light-colored boulder in the center provides the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the seated figure, follows the cliff edge down to the water, and then moves upward to the moon and magenta sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is dominated by the open sky and water, providing breathing room for the dense rock on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta and purple (sky and water reflections)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and earthy browns (rocks and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky gradients against low-value, high-contrast shadows in the foreground.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy extended sans-serif and expressive script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-bold, wide block capitals
Secondary text uses a thin, energetic hand-drawn script
Tight letter spacing for the block text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script text overlaps the block text to create depth
Block letters have a slight inner glow or bevel effect

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the central rock face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, heavy geometric block font with a fluid, organic signature-style script.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom right corner
Subtle glow behind the main title

preserve: Extended width of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky structure of the primary text
Captures the fast, handwritten feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal nocturnal landscape with a man sitting on a large central boulder. Surround him with small goats. The sky should be a vibrant magenta and purple gradient with a full moon. Apply a heavy film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, wide, yellow block-letter title in the center. Overlap the right side of the title with a thin, white, handwritten script signature.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a magenta/purple gradient?
Are there goats placed on the rocks?
Is the main text wide and bold?
Is there a heavy grain texture applied?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the figure

mustAchieve: Clear separation between foreground rock and background sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for grain consistency across the image
Ensure the moon has a soft glow
Verify the yellow text is legible against the rock
Confirm the script text looks like a natural signature
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Landscape + Central Rock Anchor + Magenta Gradient Sky + Grainy Texture + Wide Block/Script Type Pairing
